paragraphs: The X2 has been part of the BMW range since 2018, and across its single generation has used BMW's modern B-series engine family. The sDrive18d uses the B38 1.5-litre three-cylinder petrol engine, while the xDrive20d uses the B48 2.0-litre four-cylinder petrol unit — both part of the same modular family, and both covered under our same rebuild pricing tier.
about.boldParagraph: The X2 xDrive20d is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.

cards.body: A 1.5-litre three-cylinder petrol fitted to the X2 sDrive18d from 2018 to present. No specific known issue confirmed for this application. We replace timing chain components, bearings and gaskets as standard on every B38 rebuild.

cards.body: A 2.0-litre four-cylinder petrol fitted to the X2 xDrive20d from 2018 to present. No specific known issue confirmed for this application. We service it to the same standard as our other B-series rebuilds.
